headline: Is Invitation Homes (INVH) Cheap When Earnings Look Fair?
summary: Invitation Homes has delivered a decline of 12.6% over the past 5 years, and the stock now trades at about US$29.72. A Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate suggests meaningful upside, while market based multiples look roughly in line with peers. That split leaves investors weighing whether the DCF implied discount or the more neutral trading multiples provide the better guide to value today. The 12.6% share price decline over 5 years points to a stock that has not rewarded...
